name: MakeHartford
summary: Closed. A Hartford makerspace that wound down when MakerspaceCT opened downtown. Still listed as current by MakerspaceCT's own directory.

sources.note: Listed as MakeHartford, Hartford CT, in MakerspaceCT's own 'Makerspaces and Maker Resources Near You' directory.

Regional steward (MakeHaven) reports MakeHartford closed when MakerspaceCT opened. It was added here a day earlier on the strength of MakerspaceCT's own published directory, which still lists it — a peer directory outliving the space it displaced.

gaps: this record never had more than a name, a town and a URL, and now never will
